samples.question: The image shows three maze panels side by side: left, center, and right. Each panel is a black-bordered maze of black walls on a white background, and contains one green dot and one red dot. A panel CONNECTS its green dot to its red dot exactly when there is a path through the white corridors (moving without crossing any black wall) from the green dot to the red dot. Exactly one of the three panels has such a path. Which panel - left, center, or right - connects its green dot to its red dot? Answer with exactly one of left, center, or right.
